typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Cash Movements} as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		{Security Movements} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Cash_Movements as double,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Title__LinkTitle_ as string,
		Security_Movements as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Cash_Movements = {Cash Movements},
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Title__LinkTitle_ = {Title (Title)},
		Security_Movements = {Security Movements}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
